status: Full protocol queued; native environment acceptance in progress

phases.title: Source & protocol
phases.detail: Pinned upstream commit, nested dependencies and official checksums for all 12 data assets. Official training arguments captured directly.

phases.title: H800 environments
phases.detail: Native OpenGL and actual simulator scene passed. Both private CUDA toolchains installed. Policy Torch CUDA forward/backward passed; world dependencies and both compiled extension builds remain in progress.

phases.title: Release data
phases.detail: All four checkpoint assets, instructions and the full test archive passed SHA-256 and installation (6 of 12). Test index verified: 16 tasks × 40 real episodes = 640. Remaining validation/training assets are downloading with resumable retries.

phases.title: GPU acceptance
phases.detail: Actual policy Torch H800 CUDA forward/backward passed after fresh idle-utilization samples. Both environments’ rendering/KNN/FPS/PyTorch3D kernels and camera capture, then policy/WM services and batch-18 training smokes, remain pending.

phases.title: Self collection
phases.detail: Two scripted-expert successes per task, up to 20 attempts each. Keep failed attempts. Not human teleoperation.

phases.title: Full training
phases.detail: Full development-host controller queued behind environment, data and smoke gates. Shared Stage 1, PhysMani Stage 2 and 3DFA: 100,000 updates each, seed 0, three idle cards, batch 18 per card.

phases.title: Policy evaluation
phases.detail: Released and retrained PhysMani/3DFA; five checkpoints, 16 tasks, 40 episodes each: 12,800 episodes.

phases.title: World-model quality
phases.detail: 640 held-out trajectories; horizons 1/5/10 at 0.05 s per frame. PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and depth log RMSE. Object-center error requires verified GT.

blockers: Compiled extensions and full simulator/service acceptance remain pending. Full training also waits for accepted data and measured batch-18 VRAM peaks.
